title: In-store event invitation
description: Invite loyal customers to an in-store event or private shopping night with RSVP buttons. Event invitation WhatsApp template for retail.
notes: Quick-reply RSVPs give you a clean count and keep the template compact. Include date, time and store location in the body.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, you're invited to our private shopping night at {{store_name}} on {{date}} at {{time}}. Enjoy drinks, styling tips and member-only prices.
